title: The Two Towers
author: J. R. R. Tolkien
summary: With the Fellowship broken, the story follows two threads. One group is drawn into a kingdom's war against a corrupted wizard, while the two hobbits with the Ring head toward Mordor with an unreliable guide.
readIf: you have read the first book and want the middle volume, with its big battle and steadily darkening road.
skipIf: you haven't read the first volume, because it begins in the middle of the story.

pairings.reason: The final volume, which brings both threads to their conclusion.
A darker, more political epic with armies and shifting alliances for a harsher palate.
A newer epic fantasy with a massive world, war and an enduring quest.
